propositions: BindingStore embeds scattered lifecycle decisions (forward/reverse transitions, pending/confirmed, numeric-ID re-key, comment identity, absence grace, tombstones, unretire) that must be extracted into a private policy owner in binding_lifecycle.py

Production code mutates inner dictionaries via shallow all_bindings() bypass, requiring a narrow supported mutation seam (note_rich_emit or equivalent) that preserves counter/hash behavior and missing-binding fail-open semantics
Lifecycle operations must maintain at-most-one identity invariant via targeted single-key reverse pops in permitted cases only, with no new ambiguity-detection or abort behavior introduced

Comment IDs remain append-only and change-gated; legacy entries without the field remain readable without rewrite; numeric-ID re-keys rather than retire; three confirmed 404s retire and successful reads reset absence
Public facade retains every existing method/signature and shallow all_bindings() copy depth; no direct repository mutation access given to adapters or reconcilers

Tombstoned issues suppress recreate until explicit unretire; retired corruption and alert-write failures retain current fail-open boundaries; confirmed 404 grace/reset and moved-key repair behavior unchanged
